top_rule_end: A held square or diamond fuses with a circle or triangle on the ground when the textures match, or when stripes lead to checkered or checkered leads to plain.
Crystals with the same texture fuse when one is a triangle and the other a diamond, or one is a circle and the other a square.
Certain directed diamond–triangle and circle–square shape pairs fuse when their textures match or meet specific texture combinations.
Crystals fuse when they have the same texture and their shapes are circle and square or diamond and triangle.

A held square fuses with a circle when their textures match and are not stripes, when the square has stripes and the circle has plain or checkered texture, or when the square has dots and the circle has stripes; a held striped circle also fuses with a plain square.
A square and a circle fuse when they have the same texture.
A checkered crystal on the ground fuses with a held circle and a ground square, or a held square and a ground circle.
A circle and a square, or a triangle and a diamond, fuse when their textures match, the held crystal has dots, or the ground crystal is plain.
A red circle fuses with a red square only when their textures are plain and plain, dots and plain, dots and dots, or stripes and checkered, respectively.
A held crystal that is not yellow fuses with a circle on the ground if it is a square and its texture matches or it is dotted, or with a non-striped triangle if it is a diamond.
A square held crystal fuses with a circle on the ground, or a triangle held crystal fuses with a diamond on the ground, when their textures differ.
A square crystal being held fuses with a circle on the ground when their textures differ.
A triangle fuses with a diamond, and a circle fuses with a square.
A crystal fuses with a different-textured crystal whose shape is its circle-square or diamond-triangle partner.
Crystals of the same colour fuse when their textures differ and the held shape is a square paired with a circle, or a triangle paired with a diamond.
A circle fuses with a square when their textures differ.
A diamond held crystal fuses with a triangle on the ground.
The held crystal fuses with a ground crystal only when they have the same shape and texture.
The crystals must have different textures and their shapes must be circle and square, or triangle and diamond.
A square held crystal fuses with a circle on the ground, or a triangle held crystal fuses with a diamond on the ground, if their textures differ.
